about: Rigid corrections applied to fetched Poly Haven props by tools/fix_props.py (S36 asset follow-up, 2026-10-19). Each fixes a C-3 or C-4 finding of `cast.py contact-items`; the gate stays the judge.

outdoor_table_chair_set_01.why: C-3: all four feet of the chair sat 5.9 mm under the floor the table stands on (the table's feet are at y = 0). Lifted onto it.
C-3: the same 5.9 mm as chair_01.

wooden_crate_01.why: C-3: the origin sat 7.9 mm above the underside of the crate's bottom boards. The whole prop (box, lid, latch) is lifted so the boards rest on y = 0.

wall_clock.why: C-4: the second hand's hub (z 25.2-31.3 mm) was modelled straight through the hour (z 28) and minute (z 29) hands. On a movement the second hand is the outermost; it is stacked in front of the minute hand (hub from z 29.5), still behind the glass (z 35.3).

modern_ceiling_lamp_01.why: C-4: the bulb's top was 4.6 mm up inside the metal socket. Lowered 3.5 mm: it stays seated about 1 mm, so no gap shows.

street_lamp_01.why: C-4: the four lantern panes ran 5.6 mm through the corner posts. Scaled 0.95 about the lantern's axis in plan so each pane ends at its post; the height is unchanged.
C-4: the bulb's base was 4.1 mm down inside its socket. Raised 3.5 mm: it stays seated, so no gap shows.

street_lamp_02.why: C-4: street_lamp_02 carries street_lamp_01's lantern head and the same 5.6 mm pane-through-post overlap; the same correction.
C-4: the same 4.1 mm bulb-in-socket overlap as street_lamp_01.
